# Supernote reference source

Unmodified tracked files from <https://github.com/jya-dev/supernote-tool>,
commit `c1019f1c290ed5b586a9518978dbb78240b882d3`, retrieved 2026-11-13.
The canonical Apache-2.0 license is `upstream/LICENSE`; original copyright
and license headers remain intact. No files under `upstream/` are modified.

This source is retained for parser/decoder fidelity research and independent
reference rendering. It is not a newly required application runtime or an
installed Python package. Local adapters/native implementations, if selected,
are committed separately with attribution and their own validation.
